text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is one of the 37 hexagonal cells around the substation (the centre dot is its own cell, laid out as on the ground but without coordinates), coloured by the ensemble-mean field averaged over the day's valid times (run hours 9 to 33). Days: the coldest of the coldest-5% days, the most showery day for this substation, and the day nearest the median temperature.'
